stories.title: Barcelona move clear at the top after Fermín López’s double stuns Atlético Madrid
summary: They had been in a battle, they had been behind and they had been on edge, but Barcelona found a way through, holding on to their place at the top of the table and holding the doubts at bay for another day.
But they found it, two goals from Fermín López either side of the break leading them to the kind of victory that brings a reward beyond the points.

It hadn’t been easy but they had made it; ultimately, they might conclude they had found a way to manage it too, some satisfaction in the suffering, in how they resisted and re-established control amid the chaos.
